Setup

  1. Download AuroraSwitch.bin.
  2. Back up a FAT32 USB drive. Put that selector BIN at the root as the only root BIN.
  3. Safely eject, insert into Aurora, then follow the ordinary stock USB update procedure.
  4. Leave AuroraSwitch.bin at the root. Create aurora/
    and put supported original firmware BINs there with their exact catalog filenames.
  5. Keep the drive connected for firmware selection and automatic boot.

Hold any button at power-on for the menu. Keep USB connected: your last
RAM firmware choice starts automatically when its file is available. Missing or
invalid files leave the menu open.

Amber Freeze means loading. Red means loading failed; reconnect USB or check the
firmware files, then press Freeze to retry.

Aurora 1.4.4

Download ZIP

ReverbsGreen

By Qu-Bit Electronix · Firmware details

Stock spectral reverb: pitch manipulation, spectral smearing and stereo delays.

Knobs and CV

Panel knob / matching CV Function
1 Warp Pitch shift ±3 octaves; noon is unshifted; CV tracks 1 V/oct
2 Time Amplitude-domain smearing / spectral tail
3 Blur Frequency-domain smearing
4 Reflect Increasing multi-delay time zones, from no extra delay CCW
5 Mix Dry ↔ wet
6 Atmosphere Spectral/time filtering: underwater below noon, brighter then high-pass above noon

Buttons and shifted controls

Button / shifted control Function
7 Reverse Reverse audio; active LED green; state retained
8 Freeze Sustain the current spectrum; Warp/Time/Blur/Atmosphere/Mix still work
95 Shift + Mix Input gain, 0.5–4×; blue indicates default 1×
94 Shift + Reflect Stereo enhancement, 0–100%; blue indicates default 75%
97 Shift + Reverse Cycle FFT size: 4096 blue → 2048 green → 1024 cyan → 512 purple
97 Shift + Reverse, held 2 seconds Factory reset UI/options defaults; white confirmation animation
98 Shift + Freeze Reload USB settings; successful reload flashes white

Changing FFT size clears the frozen spectrum. Larger FFTs give smoother tails but more latency.

Details & sources

  • Warp LEDs: green/blue on octave; green/purple off octave.
  • CV: ±5 V; gate threshold: 0.4 V.
  • Keep settings files. Reloading settings does not update firmware.

USB options.txt defaults:

Setting Default Controls
DSP_ORDER 1 DSP order
FREEZE_WET 0 Freeze forces full-wet
LATENCY_COMP 0 Dry latency compensation
ALWAYS_BLUR 1 Always-on blur
QUANTIZE_WARP 1 Warp quantization; 2 = knob + CV
WARP_DEADZONES 1 Octave deadzones

Source: Aurora manual v1.7.4,
covering firmware 1.4.4. Calibration is maintenance, not a performance control.
